title: Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

**Lead Full Stack Engineer, EDT Innovation Lab**

  

The ED&T Innovation Lab is Stryker’s one front door for internal, non-commercial problems across our five business units and central functions. We run focused prototype sprints on real problems with real users and approved data, show progress in weekly demos and decide on evidence: stop, refine or scale. A fast, well-reasoned no is a successful outcome. What scales moves to a named delivery owner with a full handoff package; the Lab never keeps a product long term, and never bypasses Enterprise Architecture, security, compliance or QMS governance. Our promise: “Bring us the problem. We’ll test the possibility. Together we scale what works.”

We are hiring Lead Full Stack Engineer in India as founding engineers of the Lab’s build team. This is a builder’s role with a scout’s curiosity: you will take ideas from a blank repo to a working demo in days or weeks, and spend real time researching, testing and experimenting with emerging technology so the Lab always knows what is possible next. You will report to the Senior Director, ED&T Innovation Lab, and work in a small, hands-on team across the US and India.

**What you will do:**

* Own full-stack prototypes from first commit to working demo in 2–8-week sprints, spanning front end, APIs, services, data, cloud deployment and AI.
* Bring ideas to life through minimally functional prototypes tested by real users on real business problems with approved data, showcasing progress in weekly demos.
* Build AI-powered solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, tool calling, copilots, automation, and intelligent document and email processing.
* Explore emerging technologies—from AI and agents to automation, digital twins and quantum—and run time-boxed experiments, proofs of concept and technology comparisons to separate capability from hype.
* Shape technical direction for your prototypes: define architecture, break down delivery, assess existing Stryker capabilities for reuse and make evidence-based build-or-kill decisions, recognising a well-reasoned no as a successful outcome.
* Accelerate the Lab’s engineering foundations with reusable starter kits, components, templates, CI/CD pipelines and sandbox patterns, while maintaining clean code, targeted testing, secure defaults and practical documentation.
* Stay hands-on while reviewing code, pairing with and mentoring engineers, and partnering with the Lab leader to shape technical direction.
* Partner with business stakeholders and Business Innovation Partners to translate problems into buildable scope, clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.
* Turn experimentation into shared insight through concise write-ups, demos, contributions to the Lab’s quarterly innovation radar for ED&T leadership and your own experiment ideas; capture what worked, what did not, and the cost and effort to scale.
* Equip delivery teams to scale validated prototypes with a complete handoff covering architecture, data, security context and next steps, working within Enterprise Architecture, cybersecurity, data privacy and QMS guardrails from day one.

**What you need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience in delivering full-stack web applications end to end. A relevant master’s degree is a plus.
* Strong front-end expertise in React and TypeScript, or a comparable modern framework such as Angular, combined with back-end development in .NET/C#, Node.js or Python, RESTful APIs, and SQL and NoSQL data modelling.
* Hands-on cloud-native development and deployment experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure App Service, Functions, containers, storage and identity. Azure certifications and enterprise integration experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, SAP, Power Platform and Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on are advantages.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG, agents or copilots, using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs or similar technologies. Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
* A proven ability to turn concepts into working demos in days or weeks. Experience in an innovation lab, R&D group, startup, rapid product team or software-product company, alongside sustained impact and multi-year ownership across roles, will help you stand out.
* Solid engineering foundations in Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and secure coding, with effective daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and sound judgement on code review and quality.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners and deliver confident demos. Ability to collaborate with a US-based team, including regular US Eastern Time overlap for demos, stand-ups and partner sessions.
* Preferred strengths include curiosity demonstrated through open-source contributions, side projects, hackathon wins, technical writing or talks; exposure to computer vision, speech, IoT and edge, digital twins, AR/VR or quantum computing; and experience in healthcare, medical devices or other regulated industries.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
**Role Description**

The Technical Lead is an enabler in the project team. They are tasked with ensuring the development team on the project is productively working towards the technical delivery goals. They are also responsible for ensuring high functional and non-functional quality, and high code quality.

In this role, you are a force-multiplier who achieves success through leading, coaching and guiding others.

**Specific Role Responsibilities**

**Analysis and design**

* Help developers understand the problem at hand before their build starts, help them with problem decomposition.
* Provide ad-hoc consultations for developers and do pair-work when necessary (to analyse work inefficiencies and remove technical blockers).
* Collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support.
* In conjunction with solution consultants, specify and direct developers to find and reuse existing solutions for their builds, and to design their code to make future reusability as easy as possible.
* Help break large build items into sub-items (to enable more efficient and detailed progress tracking), in a way that aids smooth development.
* Take an active role in understanding the business domain and contributing to requirements gathering.

**Development**

* Supervise technical quality (e.g., by doing pair-work, ad-hoc reviews, code reviews and spot-checks in promoted code).
* Give fast, continuous feedback to developers as their build progresses.
* Support regression testing by teaching and encouraging developers to write automated tests and unit tests.

**SDLC and process oversight**

* Ensure the SDLC is adhered to by all developers submitting changes. This includes handover sessions (“Three Amigos”) functional reviews, code reviewers, test-driven development measures and ensuring good hygiene in the issue tracker.
* Ensure CI builds are green or being fixed immediately after break.
* Make sure every release has developer support allocated and problems are picked up without delay.
* Be responsible for deployment readiness and prepare complete technical stage gates for production releases.
* Actively raise risks and concerns that impact delivery or cause production issues.

**Non-functional requirements**

* Enforce correct usage of coding standards within the team.
* Take responsibility for non-functional requirements (useability, performance, security, etc.). Raise requirements and solutions that introduce issues in this space and work with colleagues to solve.

**Community and collaboration**

* Remain across company-wide initiatives development practices/principles, components, and tools and implement these on your project.
* Participate actively in local technical lead forums, communities of practice, guilds and groups to identify problems and provide solutions that enhance development across the organisation.
* Actively look for weak points (e.g., parts of system that are too difficult/costly to maintain, features with high defect rates, and scalability erns,) and provide solutions to address them.
* Assist the Head of Development with succession planning. Build depth in the team by delegating technical lead tasks to other developers.
* Liaise with network administrators, systems analysts, and software engineers to assist in resolving problems with software products or company software systems.

**Functional Area Responsibilities**

* Technical leadership of the team to ensure high productivity and quality on your assigned project.
* Responsibility for non-functional requirements.

**Experience required**

**Industry Knowledge**

First class bachelor's degree or higher and/or equivalent experience.

Experience of working on large scale technology delivery projects and successfully delivering technology change as part of these projects.

Confident, and able to take a lead role in a delivery-focused environment.

Experience of working with different levels of stakeholders within a project environment.

Expert in the FNZ platform, technologies and delivery methodologies

Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry.

Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team.

Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work.

Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.

**Required Knowledge & Skills**

* Expert in Microsoft .NET development products, including .NET, C# and SQL Server.
* Expert in web development, including ASP.NET, JavaScript and ReactJS.
* Experience with the following legacy development products would be beneficial: ASP.NET MVC, VB.NET, legacy .NET Framework versions.
* Understanding of financial products and markets.
* Understanding of web services.
* Familiar with code analysis or automated testing tools.

**About FNZ Culture**

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork.

That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.

The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.

* Customer obsessed for the long-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together

**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values**: www.fnz.com/culture

**Opportunities**

* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;
* Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances;
* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;
* We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC.

**Commitment to Equal Opportunities**

At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected.

In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us.

title: Technical Architect - Full Stack
description:

* Python: Proficiency in Python for backend services, scripting, automation, and microservices.

* APIs and Distributed Systems: Experience designing REST APIs, microservices, system integrations, and distributed applications.

* Databases: Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

* System Design: Strong understanding of system design, scalability, performance optimization, application security, and architectural patterns.

* Cloud Platforms: Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.

* People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and collaborate with multiple team leads in a large development team.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Agentic SDLC: Practical experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering and Agentic SDLC workflows.

* AI Agents and LLMs: Understanding of AI agents, LLM-powered development tools, and automation across software development activities.

* AI Across Engineering: Experience applying AI to requirements analysis, code generation, testing, code reviews, documentation, and developer productivity.

* AI Tooling: Familiarity with AI development tools and agentic frameworks, with the ability to evaluate their practical value in enterprise engineering environments.

* Continuous Improvement: A continuous-improvement mindset focused on engineering efficiency, quality, delivery predictability, and responsible AI adoption.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Shared Architectural Vision: Act as a collaborative technical leader who aligns engineers and team leads around a shared architectural vision.

* Hands-On Leadership: Balance hands-on technical problem-solving with architecture, mentoring, and technical decision-making.

* Ownership and Accountability: Encourage ownership, accountability, transparency, and effective collaboration across the team.

* Measurable AI Adoption: Drive experimentation and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices based on measurable business and delivery outcomes.

* Business Alignment: Translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions while balancing quality, maintainability, delivery timelines, and cost.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform**

**About this role**

The Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform will help build Prudential Japan's next

generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation

initiative.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that

support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business

workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams.

As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity

not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways

of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan.

What you could work on

We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Policy administration, where contract truth must

survive multiple years and a change to old insurance product must never silently break tens of

thousands of live contracts. Customer communications, where essential customer

communications reach every customer in one immovable window. CRM, where customer and

agent information and interactions are managed consistently across products and channels.

New business and policy issuance, where an application must move accurately from initial

submission through underwriting and approval to a legally effective insurance contract.

Integration, where the industry wide used services, banking and government systems meet our

systems. And the compliance records, which are essential to maintain as an insurer.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design, build and continuously improve backend services and data models for systems of

record, where a change can alter an obligation the company owes a customer rather than only

an applicationʼs behavior.

Create, maintain and enhance software capabilities and functionality across modern

technology stacks, integrations and the full software lifecycle.

Own integrations with external parties you do not control, including government and banking

systems, shared industry data services and print and delivery vendors.

Build and operate scheduled and batch processing that must finish inside a fixed window,

including month end and year end cycles.

Build and extend the audit and evidence layer: what was shown, agreed, triggered and paid,

retrievable for years.

Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality

and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.

Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to

replace and what to leave alone.

Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design,

development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.

Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for

someone to blame.

**Qualifications**

**General**

You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.

Five or more years building and operating backend systems in production, including

ownership of something that mattered when it broke.

Strong data modelling, especially temporal and bitemporal data modelling.

Transactional integrity, idempotency and reconciliation as daily practice rather than interview

vocabulary.

Integrating with external organizations where the interface is theirs and will not change for

you.

Real-time as well as batch processing at scale, with a working understanding of time windows

and dependency chains.

Any high consequence or regulated domain is an advantage: payments, healthcare, logistics,

energy, safety-critical systems.

Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen

on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up

another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.

AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills

is an advantage.

**Languages:** Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node.

Data: PostgreSQL or Aurora as the default. Experience with schema evolution on live data

matters more than any particular engine.

AWS Ecosystem

Integration: REST and event-driven patterns, plus the older shapes you will meet at the

boundary, including scheduled file exchange and message queues.

Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform or CDK or Ansible, with pipelines you have

owned rather than inherited.

Observability: Structured logging, metrics and tracing. CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry,

Dynatrace, or Datadog

Nice to have: Kafka or Kinesis, and any experience bridging a mainframe or vendor package

to modern services.

**Language**

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.

**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business

domains

* Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
* Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
* Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion
* Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and

Winning with Integrit

**Skills:** AWS , Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node , PostgreSQL or Aurora

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Full Stack Developer position provides technical expertise in building modern solutions using AI\-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and documentation without compromising architecture, security, code quality, or accountability. The role expects reliable delivery of business outcomes with predictable quality, security, and operational readiness by reducing lead time from concept to production through automation, reusable patterns, and effective AI\-assisted engineering. Transformation using Production\-grade web applications and digital services that solve measurable business problems with reusable front\-end components, APIs, microservices, integration patterns, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed across teams. The ideal candidate should have experience expertise in .NET Core, React, Python, and Azure and should leverage GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and AI\-assisted development tools.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
  
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Lead end\-to\-end solution delivery, including technical discovery, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post\-production support
* Build accessible, responsive, and high\-performing user experiences using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern UI practices
* Design and implement secure REST APIs using Microservices architecture with .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, Python, and FastAPI or Flask
* Engineer solutions using appropriate platform services, managed identities, secrets management, monitoring, and cost\-conscious design. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms
* Integrate applications with Enterprise platforms, Relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) , Messaging services, and Third\-party APIs
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes (Preferred)
* Use GitHub Copilot, Cursor Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation, Automated Unit Test Generation,
AI\-Assisted Debugging \& Refactoring to accelerate development tasks while retaining full ownership of design and code decisions. Create effective prompts and context patterns for code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and technical discovery
* Validate AI\-generated output for correctness, maintainability, licensing, security, privacy, and alignment with enterprise standards before use. Establish automated quality controls through unit, integration, API, security, and regression testing
* Protect confidential information by following approved\-tool, data\-handling, and source\-code governance requirements
* Optimise and standardize by identifying repeatable AI\-assisted workflows and convert them into documented, measurable engineering practices rather than one\-off experimentation
* Apply security\-by\-design practices across authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency management, and secure coding
* Collaborate professionally with Business SMEs, Developers, Architects, product owners, UX, security, operations, and business stakeholders
* Product mindset with strong ownership from problem definition through production outcomes
* Sound engineering judgement and the ability to balance speed, risk, maintainability, and business value
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a disciplined approach to continuous learning and experimentation

  
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field
* 8\+ years total experience with 6\+ years of hands\-on full stack software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications
* Strong expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS and responsive design
* Proficiency in Python and at least one modern API framework such as FastAPI or Flask
* Demonstrated experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integration layers, and distributed application components
* Practical Azure experience, including App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring, identity, and deployment services
* Solid understanding of automated testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, application security, performance tuning, and observability
* Core exposure to GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation
* Exposure to ITIL Principles and Change management process
